senses.gloss: m. (סָכַם; cmp. חֶשְׁבּוֹן) fixed number, amount, sum total.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:12">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>הס׳ שלהן</he> their fixed number (daily rate of bricks).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite> <he>אין אתם משלימין הס׳ וכ׳</he> you will be unable to finish your task.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130:7">Yalk. Gen. 130</cite> (expl. <cite ref="N01159"><he>נקבה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 30:28">Gen. XXX, 28</cite>) <he>ס׳ קבוע פרוש</he> define a fixed amount (v. <cite ref="O00919"><he>סְכַם</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 3:7">Tosef. Bets. III, 7</cite> <he>ס׳ מנין</he> the sum total of the amount of things (received on credit); <he>ס׳ ממכר</he> the total amount of the value of his purchases; <cite ref="Beitzah 29b:8">Bets. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ מדה</he>; <he>ס׳ מקח</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5).
